race.description: Heaven & Earth - The Trackside Legends Hcp (C4)
race.comment: MISS DE MEDICI (9) hit the line strongly when finishing just 2 lengths from the winner at Ipswich fresh up nearly 3 weeks ago, suggesting a victory is close at hand. With the blinkers on for the first time, she can take this out. JACKA STANDS ALONE (3) failed to fire at Toowoomba last time out when racing wide throughout, but he is far better than that, and from a superior gate, he can bounce straight back into the money. WOLFGANG (1) possesses good early speed and, despite drawing wide, has the pace to work across and take up a prominent position. If he secures a soft lead, he will prove difficult to run down. ROTHGO (4) needed the run when fighting on gamely for third after setting the pace. He strips fitter and can figure in the top 3 again. BEE EXACT (11) finished strongly at Ipswich last time and his form is heading the right way. Stick with him.
